parsed.draft_response:
Sorry this is happening again— I understand this is urgent and you don’t have time to repeat details. To get this fixed quickly, can you reply with the minimum info below?

1) What exactly is broken? (which feature/action fails)
2) Any error message you see (copy/paste) or a screenshot
3) When it started (approx. date/time) and whether it’s constant or intermittent
4) Your environment: web or mobile, and your browser/OS (and app version if applicable)
5) Affected scope: your account/tenant only or all users

If you have the previous ticket/incident reference for “last time,” please include it as well. Once I have this, I’ll escalate to engineering so they can investigate right away.
